title.narrative: Fostering Green Transition in Petén TEI
Fostering Green Transition in Petén TEI

description.narrative: Insatsen avser Sveriges stöd till Team Europe Iniative i Guatemala - "Fostering Green Transition in Petén". Sverige strävar efter att stödja TEI med parallell finansiering genom lokala partners Swisscontact och Conexion. Swisscontact och Conexión kommer att arbeta tillsammans i denna insats genom att gemensamt stödja Team Europe-initiativet, i syfte att stödja de fem komponenterna nedan på ett transversellt sätt - och därigenom även stödja de övergripande och specifika målen. Team Europe-initiativet syftar till den sociala och ekonomiska gröna omställningen i makroregionen Petén i Guatemala och skapandet av inkluderande hållbar och grön sysselsättning, genom följande fem komponenter: •Component 1: Tillhandahålla kapacitetsutveckling till lokala institutioner. •Komponent 2: Främja hållbar förvaltning av skogssystem. •Komponent 3: Stödja klimattåligt jordbruk. •Komponent 4: Uppmuntra hållbar turism. •Komponent 5: Förbättra hanteringen av avfall och avloppssystemen.

The contribution is Sweden's support to the Team Europe Iniative in Guatemala - "Fostering Green Transition in Petén". Sweden aims to support the TEI with parallel financing through local partners Swisscontact and Conexion. Swisscontact and Conexión will work together in this contribution by jointly supporting the Team Europe Initiative, with the aim to support all the five components in the TEI in a transverse manner - and thereby supporting the outcomes of the overall and specific abovementioned objectives. The Team Europe Initiative aims at the social and economic green transition of the Petén macro region of Guatemala and the generation of inclusive sustainable and green employment, through the following five components. • Component 1: Provide capacity development to local institutions. • Component 2: Foster sustainable management of forest systems. • Component 3: Assist climate resilient agriculture. • Component 4: Encourage sustainable tourism. • Component 5: Improve solid waste management and sewage systems.

Overall Objective
To link socioeconomic development in the Department of Petén with protection of the environment and sustainable use of natural resources with gender and cultural pertinence approach.
Specific Objectives (results) are:
1. Improve policy framework and financing for inclusive green economic development in Petén
2. Increase sustainable production and productivity of agriculture, livestock, forestry and tourism
3. Improve waste and waste water management services in the municipalities of Petén-Itzá basin

sector.narrative: Water sector policy and administrative management

description.narrative:
Results obtained up to date
Objective 1: Improving the policy and financing framework for the development of an inclusive green economy in Petén, capacity building
- Strengthening members of the El Bloque Governance Unit through signing of letter of understanding, an action managed by ProPetén
- Preparation of 4 capacity assessments for El Bloque institutions
- Creation of competencies in SEGEPLAN for submitting projects to CONADUR
- Creation of CONAP Automation Platform for Online Services
- Strengthening use of drones for monitoring and detecting forest fires in forest concessions and for El Bloque
Objective 2: Sustainable forest management; increase sustainable production and productivity in agriculture, livestock, forestry, and tourism
- Purchase and operation of sawmill for FORESCOM, increasing the added value of its products
- Control and surveillance patrols/fire prevention and fighting in forestry concessions
- Supplies for fire prevention and fighting in El Bloque
- Nearly 25,000 hectares preserved during the fire season 2024
- Activation of 21 Community Forest Fire Committees (CIF-C) around El Bloque
- Creation of green business activation fund and connectivity system for using FINTECH tools to collect payments for products and services in the block area
Objective 3: Climate-Resilient Agriculture and Sustainable Livestock
- Evaluation and design of profitability models: SAFs and silvopastoral systems
- Main progress to date with Zamorano and Texas Tech University: Prospecting visit to select installation sites for regenerative agriculture and slow tourism intervention areas
- Generate proposals for regenerative agriculture and slow tourism
- Start of capacity building for ecological connectivity network promoted by ProPetén with 40 Indigenous organizations
- Three groups of Indigenous women and youth (160 participants) in the Mayan Biosphere Reserve using sustainable agricultural practices, process and market their products locally and have begun to receive support on business and financial management issues
- Work has begun with beekeeping value chain, defining the links in the chain to propose an "inclusive market system"
- Support for a group of producers along the Yaxhá route to establish a pilot plan for regenerative agriculture linked to tourism
Objective 4: Sustainable Tourism
- Labor market study is conducted to understand the supply and demand of tourism, forestry (timber and non-timber), agroindustry and agriculture sectors in the municipalities of Melchor de Mencos, San Andrés, San José, San Benito, and Flores in the department of Petén
- "Employability Coaching" for groups of young people and women (60 people in total) to receive coaching training (support and training) on relevant topics related to vocational and career guidance. Additionally, topics such as violence prevention, the care economy, and self-esteem were addressed
Objective 5: Solid Waste and Sanitation
- Update of the integrated solid waste management plans for the Lake Peten Itzá basin
- Academic design of the diploma program "Innovation in Waste Management: From Problem Identification to Financial Proposals"
- Collaboration in the organization of the "Guardians of the Lake" diploma program in coordination with AMPI
- Training for 300 students from the Barrio Norte San Andrés National Institute of Basic Education
- Coordination of the Third Symposium of the Lake Peten Itzá Basin, with the theme of Integrated Solid Waste Management. Focus on circular economy and dissemination of technologies that allow for the improvement of ISWM
- Main progress to date Academic design of the diploma program "Innovation in Waste Management: From Problem Identification to Financial Proposals"
- Pre-feasibility study of a non-recoverable waste processing plant
No indicator available - only a description of the activity results is published
